title: The Dimitrov mausoleum
episode: A Better Tomorrow:  The Georgi Dimitrov Mausoleum
place: Former site of the Georgi Dimitrov Mausoleum
description: A talk on the mausoleum built in six days in 1949 for Georgi Dimitrov, Bulgaria’s first communist leader, whose embalmed body lay there until 1990. The government blew it up in 1999. It took four blasts to bring it down.

title: The death of Tsar Boris
description: Tsar Boris III died suddenly in August 1943, days after a stormy meeting with Hitler, and many Bulgarians believed he was poisoned. He had refused to send his army against the Soviet Union. His palace is now the National Gallery.
